summary: Remove the retired catalog archive and direct-actor discovery family

replay.detail: No event replay or recovery path changes. The removed modules were reached only by the retired catalog supervisor, whose root executable was removed in #4629.

schema.detail: No database schema change. Old catalog archive directories, tombstones and observation ledgers are neither read nor deleted by this change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or member activation change.

compatibility.detail: Removes the workspace-internal fractal_drivers::catalog_archive and direct_actor modules, the supervisor archive report field and archive-only PTY snapshot hook. Current CLI, daemon, wire and native harness paths do not call this family. The catalog parser and native catalog-resolution compatibility paths remain available.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption. This removes code with no current product entry point.

manual.detail: Existing installations need no cleanup. Previously archived catalog data remains on disk unchanged; this change does not migrate or remove it.

recovery.detail: No store or runtime recovery change and no new downgrade requirement. Reverting restores the removed library implementation without changing persisted data.
